hooks.prompt:
Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

If stop_hook_active is true, return {"ok": true}.

Read last_assistant_message. Return {"ok": false, "reason": "Don't ask for approval of something already decided. Do it, then report. Ask only when blocked by a decision no one has made or by a conflict."} if the message ends by asking the user to approve or confirm any of: applying fixes for findings, rerunning a review or test, committing or pushing, or continuing to a next step the conversation already agreed. Otherwise return {"ok": true}. Ending a turn to wait for background work that is still running is allowed. A question about a decision no one has made yet, or about a conflict between agreed things, is allowed.
